title: Construct role flavor overlay
description: Frontmatter contract for skills/roles/<role>.<flavor>.md files. Every overlay declares which profile(s) it applies to and counts toward a per-role cap so flavors do not sprawl.

role.description: Role id, optionally with a .flavor suffix. e.g. architect, architect.ai-systems

profiles.description: Curated profiles this overlay applies to. Default for migrated files: [rnd]. Custom profiles are validated against this field by lib/profiles/validate-custom.mjs.

cap.description: Count toward the per-role flavor cap. Always 1 today; reserved for future weighting.
